title: When
description: An event schedule with individual occurrences and repeating recurrences. Scheduled timestamps and recurrence calculations use UTC; timezone is display metadata. Child durations override the default duration.

id.description: Globally unique identifier for this schedule.

entityType.description: Entity type discriminator. Always "When" for When entities.

updatedAt.description: UTC timestamp when this schedule record was last updated.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name for displaying UTC schedule timestamps; does not change recurrence timing.

duration.description: Nonnegative ISO 8601 event duration used when a child entity omits its duration.

occurrences.description: Occurrence entities defining individual scheduled event times.

recurrences.description: Recurrence entities defining repeating event schedules.
